crossRefs.note: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
“ ‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “ ‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all…
If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper…
But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out…
But I have sent the brothers that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said…
that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

translations.web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
translations.bsb: Do not tell your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I will provide”— when you already have the means.

translations.asv: Say not unto thy neighbor, Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give; When thou hast it by thee.
